import sys

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    t = int(input_data[0])
    idx = 1
    out = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input_data[idx]); m = int(input_data[idx+1]); idx += 2
        cnt = [0]*64
        total = 0
        for i in range(m):
            a = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
            total += a
            cnt[a.bit_length()-1] += 1
        if total < n:
            out.append("-1")
            continue
        ans = 0
        need = n
        for b in range(63):
            if (need >> b) & 1:
                if cnt[b] > 0:
                    cnt[b] -= 1
                else:
                    j = b + 1
                    while j < 64 and cnt[j] == 0:
                        j += 1
                    while j > b:
                        cnt[j] -= 1
                        cnt[j-1] += 2
                        ans += 1
                        j -= 1
                    cnt[b] -= 1
            cnt[b+1] += cnt[b] // 2
        out.append(str(ans))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
